style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, no drawn overlays
motion_rule: HE is the subject of every window and moves it; his body crosses the frame edge to edge in EVERY window, talking ones too, always SIDEWAYS, NEVER toward or away from the lens; legs in shot, nothing between him and the lens, never facing the lens while talking; new shot size every window; the last frame still moves
character: a glossy red lobster in a black tailcoat, a monocle, a gold signet ring on his big claw, whipping antennae, ONE huge claw and one small
second_characters: ONE plump crab in a bow tie, waiting on him
props: CARD: one blank cream price card on a string
prop_continuity: the same card streaming from his small claw; the glass dome rolls over the gravel beside or behind him, never in front of his body; the dome rolls to the last frame; speech is only heard, never shown
environment: the WHOLE clip is INSIDE a rich glass tank, underwater, gravel floor, a marble table with grapes beyond the glass
lighting: bright chandelier light through the glass, high exposure

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: deep chesty male voice, calm and unhurried, even 4.3 syllables per second
audio.pacing: speech 0.7-2.5 and 2.9-7.9; voiceless outside, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: mouth and mandibles open on every syllable
audio.sfx: water swirl, gravel spray, claw snaps, cutlery beyond the glass, the dome rumbling from 7.9 on

timeline.a: silent. THE LOBSTER is already at top speed in frame one and rakes the tank left to right past the lens
THE LOBSTER kicks off the glass and crosses back right to left, THE CRAB tumbling under him
THE LOBSTER cartwheels claw over tail edge to edge, gravel bursting at every touch
THE LOBSTER vaults over THE CRAB, snatches the dome off him and slings it rolling over the gravel
THE LOBSTER drops on his back and rips edge to edge on it, claws pedalling, gravel at the lens
still on his back THE LOBSTER whips his tail and shoots back the other way past THE CRAB
THE LOBSTER rolls upright and climbs the gravel slope the whole frame height, legs hammering
THE LOBSTER launches off the slope and sails edge to edge over THE CRAB, the card streaming after him
THE LOBSTER slams the gravel and rebounds bottom of frame to top, gravel bursting under him
THE LOBSTER tears edge to edge past the lens, the card snapping behind him
THE LOBSTER doubles back along the glass the other way, THE CRAB running under him, the dome rolling behind
THE LOBSTER boots the rolling dome sideways and gallops edge to edge alongside it, gravel in a wave
the dome overtakes him across the frame and scoops him up mid-stride, he keeps running inside it, the card hooked on its rim
the dome rolls him edge to edge past the lens, he runs inside it and winks, monocle flashing, gravel and dome still going in the last frame

must_appear: THE LOBSTER snatching the dome at 2.5, the card hooked on the rim at 8.6, the dome scooping him up and the wink at 9.3, tailcoat and monocle throughout, grapes in shot
negative_prompt: speech bubble, comic balloon, cyrillic, subtitles, watermark, the hero outside the tank, night, dark scene, a still camera, a push in, the hero moving toward or away from the lens, macro on a small prop, the dome in front of his body, a frozen final frame, slow motion, any word after 7.9, silence in the tail
